connector.name: Odgs MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: ODGS governance enforcement - validation, regulation compilation, drift detection, signed S-Certs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package odgs-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.metricprovenance, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ODGS_PROJECT_ROOT
env.description: Path to the ODGS project root containing governance definitions (judiciary/, legislative/, executive/). Defaults to the current working directory.

env.name: ODGS_API_KEY
env.description: Metric Provenance licence key for Pro/Enterprise tier tools (compile_regulation, check_drift, detect_conflicts, narrate_audit, discover_bindings, download_pack). Omit for community-tier access (validate_payload, governance_score, list_packs, conformance_check).
